test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

A sudden violent event that brings about great loss or destruction
solution:
The correct answer is: **Catastrophe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Catastrophe"** means a sudden violent event that brings about great loss or destruction. (आपदा)

 
 
• **Example:** The earthquake was a catastrophe that left thousands of people homeless.
 
 
 
• **"Blockbuster"** refers to something, especially a film or book, that is a great commercial success. (सुपरहिट)
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was a blockbuster, breaking all box office records.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct one-word substitute for a sudden violent event that brings about great loss or destruction is **'Catastrophe'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Catastrophe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Blockbuster** (सुपरहिट): Something, especially a film or book, that is a great commercial success.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was a blockbuster, breaking all box office records.
 
 
 
• **Farce** (मूर्खतापूर्ण नाटक): A comic dramatic work using buffoonery and horseplay.
 
 
• **Example:** The play turned out to be a farce, full of ridiculous situations and slapstick humor.
 
 
 
• **Intrigue** (षड्यंत्र): The secret planning of something illicit or detrimental.
 
 
• **Example:** The novel is full of intrigue, with numerous plot twists and hidden agendas.
 
 

 

108:Tbd4,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
